bias_targets.methodology: Surveying and synthesizing existing evaluation benchmarks and metrics in machine translation, including the use of synthetic challenge sets (e.g., WinoMT) to measure occupational stereotyping and pronoun resolution, and natural corpora (e.g., MuST-SHE, Arabic Parallel Gender Corpus) to evaluate speaker gender preservation and agreement.

Reviewing studies that apply demographic classifiers to machine translation outputs to determine if systems systematically alter the perceived age of the speaker (e.g., making text sound like it was written by older authors).
